name: Segment tissue types using FSL Fast
summary: Segments a brain-masked T1-weighted image into CSF, gray matter and white matter with FSL FAST, producing hard segmentations and partial-volume maps.
description: Applies the brain mask to the T1 with fslmaths and runs FSL fast (-g -N -p), writing the labelled segmentation as mask.nii.gz plus per-tissue binary, probability and partial-volume images. Use it for tissue masks or partial-volume estimates.

inputs.requirements: Must be on the same voxel grid as the brain mask.

inputs.description: Brain mask of the T1, used to skull-strip it before FAST.

outputs.description: Tissue segmentation (mask.nii.gz) plus CSF/GM/WM-seg, -probseg and -pveseg images.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.cause: FAST did not produce a segmentation.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the T1 and mask are aligned and the mask is not empty.
